notes: NWC construction (absolute values in historical and NWC % in forecast) is defined as (accounts receivable + inventories + other current assets) minus (accounts payable + accrued compensation and related benefits + other accrued liabilities). This excludes cash, short-term investments, and income tax liabilities because these are separately disclosed and would otherwise create large, model-distorting swings. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000143774925005903/mpwr20241231_10k.htm))

DA is taken directly from the cash flow statement line item 'Depreciation and amortization' (not limited to PP&E depreciation). ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Capex is taken as 'Purchases of property and equipment' from the cash flow statement; used as absolute capex (modeled as a % of sales in forecasts). ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Comps EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA are best-effort from third-party sources; several retrieved snippets do not explicitly state NTM methodology, so those fields may reflect trailing or mixed horizons. ([ca.finance.yahoo.com](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/quote/TXN/key-statistics/?utm_source=openai))

NOL balance uses disclosed state and foreign net operating loss carryforwards as of Dec 31, 2025; an NOL utilization fraction is assumed (0.80) due to lack of an explicit utilization schedule. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

catalysts: Continued strength in power management content for AI/data-center and other enterprise design wins sustaining above-cycle demand. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000143774925005903/mpwr20241231_10k.htm))

Further margin expansion from favorable mix and operating leverage if revenue sustains the current growth path. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Capital return and balance-sheet flexibility if liquidity remains strong through the cycle (cash/short-term investments remain elevated). ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))
company_overview: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) is a fabless semiconductor company providing high-performance power electronics solutions for end markets including enterprise data, automotive, communications, consumer, and industrial. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Business model uses third-party manufacturing/assembly and focuses on IC design to manage capital intensity and fixed-cost structure. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

2025 delivered $2.79B revenue with operating margin of 26.1%, supported by stronger end-market demand and product mix. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))
current_context: Most recent annual filing (FY ended Dec 31, 2025; filed Feb 27, 2026) reports 2025 revenue of $2.79B (+26.4% YoY) and operating income of $728.6M. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Cash and cash equivalents were $1.10B with $157.2M of short-term investments as of Dec 31, 2025 (liquidity supports capital return and operating resilience). ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Effective tax rate is below the U.S. statutory rate, with 2025 income tax expense of $144.7M on $766.2M pre-tax income (tax rate assumption anchored to FY 2025). ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))
investment_highlights: Revenue growth in the base case reflects sustained demand tailwinds and product-mix benefits versus the 2023-2025 upcycle. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled to normalize from 2024’s lower margin (~24.4%) toward the 2025 level (~26.1%) with modest improvement through 2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000143774925005903/mpwr20241231_10k.htm))

Depreciation and amortization are modeled as a modest percent of sales (rising gradually) consistent with the company’s historical cash flow depreciation. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Capex intensity is kept relatively contained (semiconductor fabless design), with normalization after 2024’s elevated purchases of property and equipment. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000143774925005903/mpwr20241231_10k.htm))

Working capital is modeled using a consistent non-cash NWC definition to avoid over-counting cash and investments in the DCF. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000143774925005903/mpwr20241231_10k.htm))
key_risks: Semiconductor end-market cyclicality could drive revenue downshifts and margin compression versus the modeled normalization. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Working capital swings and capex timing could differ from model assumptions, particularly around inventory and supplier payment terms. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))

Tax rate volatility (including utilization/valuation of tax assets) could deviate from the FY 2025-anchored tax rate assumption. ([media.monolithicpower.com](https://media.monolithicpower.com/mps_cms_document/m/p/mps_2025_form_10-k.pdf))
